sceneDescription: A hyper-realistic, wide-angle photo of a city marathon in progress. Instead of batons, runners in mid-stride are passing luxurious, oversized perfume bottles and makeup compacts to each other as relay batons. The handoff is captured at the exact dramatic moment, with one runner's hand reaching out for a velvet-lined, open cosmetics case held out like a prized treasure. In the background, a glitzy, velvet-roped velvet podium sits where a marathon finish line would be, guarded by a security guard in formal attire. Scattered along the race route are velvet pillows with mundane household items set atop them—like a can opener and a hairbrush—displayed with reverence, as if they're precious. Natural daylight, street-level angle, shallow depth of field, all activity in the central horizontal band. The absurdity is in the extreme luxury and precious treatment of everyday objects and cosmetics in a high-energy athletic setting, with implied urgency and movement.
